source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 17 (PDF 4-16), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Group 2 Elements) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Group 2 elements are called alkaline earth metals because of:
(Group 2 elements ko alkaline earth metals kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: sirf samandar ke paani mein maujoodgi
p block mein un ki jagah
un ki metallic fitrat aur zameen ki crust mein maujoodgi

blocks.explanation: Inhein alkaline earth metals un ki metallic fitrat aur zameen ki crust mein paaye jaane ki wajah se kehte hain (17.1).

book_ref.quote: They are also called the alkaline earth metals due to their metallic nature

blocks.prompt:
2 In reactivity, the Group 2 metals lie between:
(Reactivity (tez amal) mein Group 2 metals kin ke darmiyan hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 metals ki reactivity bohat reactive alkali metals aur kam reactive transition metals ke darmiyan hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: having reactivity between highly reactive alkali metals and less reactive transition metals

blocks.prompt:
3 Which two Group 2 elements are among the eight most widely occurring elements in the earth crust?
(Group 2 ke kaun se do elements zameen ki crust ke aath sab se aam elements mein shamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq Ca aur Mg zameen ki crust ke aath sab se zyada paaye jaane wale elements mein hain (17.1).

book_ref.quote: Ca and Mg are among the eight most widely occurring elements in the earth crust

blocks.prompt:
4 Which Group 2 element is an important part of chlorophyll?
(Kaun sa Group 2 element chlorophyll (paudon ka sabz maadda) ka aham hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mg chlorophyll ka aham hissa hai jo paudon ka sabz maadda hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: Mg is an important part of chlorophyll, the green matter in plants

blocks.prompt:
5 Which Group 2 element is used to make copper alloys harder for aerospace materials?
(Kaun sa Group 2 element aerospace materials ke liye copper alloys ko sakht banane mein istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Be copper alloys (dhaat ke mixture) ko aerospace ke liye sakht banata hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: Be is used to make copper alloys harder for aerospace materials

blocks.prompt:
6 Group 2 elements show similar chemical properties because they all have:
(Group 2 elements ki chemical properties milti julti kyun hain?)

options.text: bahari s subshell mein aik electron (ns¹)
bahari s subshell mein do electrons (ns²)
bharpoor p subshell valence shell ke taur par

blocks.explanation: Sab Group 2 elements ke bahari s subshell mein do electrons (ns²) hain, is liye un ki chemical properties milti julti hain (17.1).

book_ref.quote: therefore, they exhibit similar chemical properties

blocks.prompt:
7 According to Table 17.1, the electron configuration of strontium is:
(Table 17.1 ke mutabiq strontium ki electron configuration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Strontium (atomic number 38) ki configuration [Kr] 5s² hai (Table 17.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 17.1 Properties of Group 2 (Be–Ba)

blocks.prompt:
8 From Table 17.1, the metallic radius (pm) changes from Be to Ba as:
(Table 17.1 ke mutabiq Be se Ba tak metallic radius (pm) kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Metallic radius group mein neeche barhta hai: Be 112, Mg 160, Ca 197, Sr 215, Ba 222 pm. 31-135 wali values M²⁺ ke ionic radii hain (Table 17.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 17.1 Properties of Group 2 (Be–Ba)

blocks.prompt:
9 Which Group 2 element has the highest first ionization energy in Table 17.1?
(Table 17.1 mein kis Group 2 element ki pehli ionization energy sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli ionization energy group mein neeche kam hoti hai: Be 900 sab se zyada hai (Table 17.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 17.1 Properties of Group 2 (Be–Ba)

blocks.prompt:
10 Using Table 17.1, the sum of the first and second ionization energies of magnesium is:
(Table 17.1 ki madad se magnesium ki pehli aur doosri ionization energy ka majmooa kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mg ke liye: 738 + 1451 = 2189 (table ki values). 2657 Be ka aur 1468 Ba ka majmooa hai (Table 17.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 17.1 Properties of Group 2 (Be–Ba)

blocks.prompt:
11 Which Group 2 element has the highest melting point (°C) in Table 17.1?
(Table 17.1 mein kis Group 2 element ka melting point (°C) sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Be ka melting point 1287 °C sab se zyada hai; melting points seedhi tarteeb mein kam nahi hote (Mg 650, Ca 842) (Table 17.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 17.1 Properties of Group 2 (Be–Ba)

blocks.prompt:
12 Which Group 2 element has the lowest density in Table 17.1?
(Table 17.1 mein kis Group 2 element ki density sab se kam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Densities: Be 1.85, Mg 1.74, Ca 1.54, Sr 2.64, Ba 3.51 g/cm³; Ca sab se kam hai (Table 17.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 17.1 Properties of Group 2 (Be–Ba)

blocks.prompt:
13 The irregular trends in melting point and density of Group 2 metals are related to:
(Group 2 metals ke melting point aur density ke be-tarteeb trends kis se mutaliq hain?)

options.text: oxygen ke saath un ka reaction

blocks.explanation: Melting point aur density ka trend group mein metal atoms ki mukhtalif packing (tarteeb) se mutaliq hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: The trend in melting point and density are related to the different packing of the metal atoms down the group

blocks.prompt:
14 The standard electrode potential (E°) of Group 2 elements, from Be to Ba:
(Group 2 elements ka standard electrode potential (E°) Be se Ba tak:)

options.text: negative se positive ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: E° Be se Ba tak zyada negative hota jata hai (Ba −2.91 V sab se zyada negative), jo barhti reactivity ke mutabiq hai (Table 17.1).

book_ref.quote: Standard Electrode Potential (E°)

blocks.prompt:
15 Mg, Ca, Sr and Ba are essential components of fireworks because of their:
(Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba fireworks (aatish baazi) ka zaroori hissa kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba apne shokh shoalon ke rangon ki wajah se fireworks ka zaroori hissa hain (17.1).

book_ref.quote: Most firework colours are due to Group 2 element

blocks.prompt:
16 Group 2 atoms become stable ions by losing two electrons. The ion formed is:
(Group 2 atoms do electrons kho kar stable ions bante hain. Banne wala ion kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do ns² electrons khone ke baad woh +2 charge wale stable ions M²⁺ bante hain (17.1.1).

book_ref.quote: After losing these two electrons, they become stable ions with a +2 charge (M²⁺)

blocks.prompt:
17 Which statement correctly explains why reactivity increases from Be to Ba?
(Be se Ba tak reactivity kyun barhti hai? Sahi bayan chunein.)

options.text: Size aur shielding barhti hai jabke ionization energy kam hoti hai
Size kam aur ionization energy zyada hoti hai
Valence electrons par mehsoos nuclear charge barhta hai
Valence electrons ki tadaad barhti hai

blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche size aur shielding barhti hai aur ionization energy kam hoti hai, is liye electrons nikalna aasaan aur reactivity zyada hoti hai (17.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The reactivity increases from Be to Ba due to the increase in size, shielding effect and decrease in the ionization energy down the group

blocks.prompt:
18 The correct reactivity order of Group 2 elements is:
(Group 2 elements ki reactivity ki sahi tarteeb kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reactivity series Be se Ba tak barhti hai: Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba (17.1.1).

book_ref.quote: It shows that Be is the least reactive and Ba is the most reactive element of Group 2

blocks.prompt:
19 Down Group 2, the removal of the valence electrons becomes:
(Group 2 mein neeche valence electrons ka nikalna kaisa ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bara size, zyada shielding aur kam ionization energy electrons ka nikalna aasaan bana dete hain (17.1.1).

book_ref.quote: This makes the removal of electrons easier, and the reactivity increases

blocks.prompt:
20 When a Group 2 metal M burns in oxygen, the general product is:
(Jab Group 2 metal M oxygen mein jalta hai to aam product kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab Group 2 metals oxygen mein jal kar MO oxides banate hain: 2M + O₂ → 2MO (17.2.1).

book_ref.quote: All Group 2 metals burn in oxygen to form metal oxides (MO)

blocks.prompt:
21 Beryllium is less reactive towards oxygen than the other Group 2 members because:
(Beryllium oxygen ke saath doosre members se kam reactive kyun hai?)

options.text: us ke koi valence electrons nahi
aik patli, mazboot oxide layer usay bachati hai

blocks.explanation: Be sirf zyada temperature (600 °C se upar) par oxygen se reaction karta hai; aik patli magar mazboot oxide layer usay bachati hai (17.2.1).

book_ref.quote: A thin, strong oxide layer usually protects it

blocks.prompt:
22 Beryllium reacts with oxygen to form BeO at temperatures:
(Beryllium oxygen se kis temperature par BeO banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Beryllium 600 °C se zyada temperature par oxygen se BeO banata hai (17.2.1).

book_ref.quote: reacts with oxygen at high temperatures

blocks.prompt:
23 Calcium burns in oxygen with a:
(Calcium oxygen mein kis tarah jalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ca ka oxygen se reaction zyada tez hai aur brick red (eent jaisa surkh) shoala deta hai (17.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The reaction of calcium (Ca) with oxygen is more vigorous to give a brick red flame

blocks.prompt:
24 Magnesium burns brightly in air to form:
(Magnesium hawa mein chamak kar jalta hai aur kya banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mg hawa ya oxygen mein chamak kar jalta hai aur magnesium oxide MgO banata hai (17.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Magnesium (Mg) burns brightly in air or oxygen to form magnesium oxide (MgO)

blocks.prompt:
25 The oxides of Group 2 elements are generally:
(Group 2 elements ke oxides aam tor par kaise hote hain?)

options.text: safaid solids, basic, neeche zyada basic
safaid solids, acidic, neeche zyada acidic

blocks.explanation: Group 2 oxides aam tor par safaid solids, basic hote hain aur un ka basic character group mein neeche barhta hai (17.2.1).

book_ref.quote: generally white solids and basic in nature and their basic character increases down the group

blocks.prompt:
26 When one oxide ion of a Group 2 oxide reacts with water, the number of hydroxide ions produced is:
(Group 2 oxide ka aik oxide ion paani se reaction kare to kitne hydroxide ions bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oxide ion paani se reaction kar ke hydroxide ions banata hai: O²⁻(s) + H₂O(l) → 2OH⁻(aq) (17.2.1).

book_ref.quote: due to the reaction between the oxide ion and water to produce the OH⁻ ion

blocks.prompt:
27 Which statement about beryllium and water is correct?
(Beryllium aur paani ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?)

options.text: Be reacts explosively with cold water
Be reacts with steam to give BeO and H₂
Be does not react with water or steam even when heated
Be reacts slowly with cold water to give Be(OH)₂

blocks.explanation: Beryllium apni hifazati oxide layer ki wajah se garam karne par bhi paani ya steam se reaction nahi karta (17.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Beryllium (Be) does not react with water or steam, even when heated

blocks.prompt:
28 Group 2 metals (except Be) react with water to give:
(Group 2 metals (Be ke ilawa) paani se reaction kar ke kya dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Be ke ilawa Group 2 metals paani se metal hydroxide M(OH)₂ aur hydrogen gas banate hain (17.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Except beryllium (Be), other Group 2 metals react with water to produce metal hydroxides

blocks.prompt:
29 The magnesium compound formed with steam differs from that formed with cold water. With steam the product is:
(Steam ke saath banne wala magnesium compound thande paani wale se mukhtalif hai. Steam ke saath product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Steam ke saath Mg tez reaction karta hai: Mg(s) + H₂O(g) → MgO(s) + H₂(g) (17.2.2).

book_ref.quote: With steam, it reacts faster to form magnesium oxide (MgO) and hydrogen

blocks.prompt:
30 The reaction of magnesium with cold water is:
(Magnesium ka thande paani se reaction kaisa hai?)

options.text: dhamake daar, MgO aur O₂ banta hai
bohat aahista, Mg(OH)₂ aur H₂ banta hai

blocks.explanation: Mg thande paani se bohat aahista reaction kar ke Mg(OH)₂ aur H₂ banata hai; steam ke saath tez (17.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Magnesium (Mg) reacts very slowly with cold water, forming Mg(OH)₂ and H₂

blocks.prompt:
31 When calcium reacts with water, a white precipitate appears because:
(Calcium ke paani se reaction mein safaid precipitate kyun banta hai?)

options.text: Ca(OH)₂ bohat kam hal hota hai

blocks.explanation: Ca paani se tez reaction kar ke Ca(OH)₂ aur H₂ deta hai; Ca(OH)₂ kam hal hota hai is liye safaid precipitate (tah-nasheen) banta hai (17.2.2).

book_ref.quote: The calcium hydroxide is sparingly soluble, forming a white precipitate

blocks.prompt:
32 Compared with magnesium, calcium reacts with cold water:
(Magnesium ke muqable mein calcium thande paani se kaise reaction karta hai?)

options.text: sirf 600 °C se upar garam karne par

blocks.explanation: Calcium thande paani aur steam se magnesium ke muqable mein zyada tezi se reaction karta hai (17.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Calcium (Ca) reacts with cold water and steam more vigorously than magnesium

blocks.prompt:
33 The basic character of Group 2 hydroxides increases down the group due to:
(Group 2 hydroxides ka basic character group mein neeche kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 hydroxides Group 1 se kam basic hain, magar barhti solubility (hal pazeeri) ki wajah se un ka basic character neeche barhta hai (17.2.2).

book_ref.quote: The hydroxides of Group 2 are less basic than the Group 1 elements

blocks.prompt:
34 Group 2 metals react with dilute hydrochloric acid to form:
(Group 2 metals dilute hydrochloric acid se kya banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: M(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MCl₂(aq) + H₂(g): namak (salt) aur hydrogen gas (17.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Group 2 metals react with dilute acids to produce a salt and hydrogen gas

blocks.prompt:
35 The reaction of beryllium with dilute acids can be slow because of:
(Beryllium ka dilute acids se reaction aahista kyun ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Be dilute acids se BeCl₂ aur H₂ banata hai, magar us ki hifazati oxide layer reaction ko aahista kar sakti hai (17.2.3).

book_ref.quote: but its protective oxide layer can slow this reaction

blocks.prompt:
36 The reaction of calcium with dilute sulphuric acid can stop early because:
(Calcium ka dilute sulphuric acid se reaction jaldi kyun ruk sakta hai?)

options.text: calcium acids se reaction nahi karta
kam hal hone wala CaSO₄ metal ki satah dhaanp leta hai
H₂ gas metal ko hal kar deti hai
CaSO₄ gas ban kar nikal jata hai

blocks.explanation: Banne wala CaSO₄ kam hal hota hai aur metal ki satah par hifazati teh bana deta hai, is liye reaction jaldi ruk jata hai (17.2.3).

book_ref.quote: the reaction can stop early because the calcium sulphate (CaSO₄) formed is sparingly soluble

blocks.prompt:
37 Magnesium reacts with dilute sulphuric acid to give:
(Magnesium dilute sulphuric acid se kya deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mg(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → MgSO₄(aq) + H₂(g) (17.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Magnesium (Mg) reacts readily with dilute acids

blocks.prompt:
38 Which equation for calcium with dilute HCl is correctly balanced?
(Calcium aur dilute HCl ki kaun si equation sahi balanced hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ca(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂(g); Ca se Ca²⁺ banta hai is liye do Cl⁻ chahiye (17.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Calcium (Ca) reacts vigorously with dilute acids to form calcium salts and hydrogen gas

blocks.prompt:
39 If 0.5 mol of a Group 2 metal reacts completely with excess dilute HCl, the amount of H₂ formed is:
(Agar kisi Group 2 metal ke 0.5 mol excess dilute HCl se poori tarah reaction karein to kitni H₂ banegi?)
blocks.explanation: M + 2HCl → MCl₂ + H₂: 1 mol M se 1 mol H₂, is liye 0.5 mol M se 0.5 mol H₂ (17.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Group 2 metals react with dilute acids to produce a salt and hydrogen gas

blocks.prompt:
40 The key differences between Group 1 and Group 2 metals are mainly due to differences in their:
(Group 1 aur Group 2 metals ke aham farq zyada tar kis farq ki wajah se hain?)

options.text: un ke oxides ke boiling points

blocks.explanation: Group 1 aur Group 2 ke aham farq un ki ionization energies ke farq ki wajah se hain (17.3).

book_ref.quote: they show key differences due to the difference in their ionization energies

blocks.prompt:
41 Group 2 metals are generally less reactive than Group 1 metals of the same period because:
(Group 2 metals usi period ke Group 1 metals se kam reactive kyun hain?)

options.text: do electrons khone ke liye zyada energy chahiye
un ka sirf aik valence electron hai
un ki ionization energies kam hain

blocks.explanation: Group 2 metals do electrons khote hain jis ke liye zyada energy chahiye, is liye woh usi period ke Group 1 se kam reactive hain (17.3).

book_ref.quote: Group 2 metals lose two electrons, which requires more energy

blocks.prompt:
42 Which property belongs to Group 1 metals rather than Group 2 metals?
(Kaun si khasiyat Group 2 ki bajaye Group 1 metals ki hai?)

options.text: Bohat naram, chaaqu se kat jata hai

blocks.explanation: Group 1 metals bohat naram hain (chaaqu se kat jate hain); Group 2 sakht hain, M²⁺ aur MO banate hain aur un ke melting points zyada hain (Table 17.2).

book_ref.quote: Very soft (can be cut with a knife).

blocks.prompt:
43 The oxides of Group 1 and Group 2 metals have the general formulae respectively:
(Group 1 aur Group 2 metals ke oxides ke aam formulas tarteeb se kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group 1 M₂O (jaise Na₂O, bohat basic) aur Group 2 MO (jaise CaO, kam basic) banata hai (Table 17.2).

book_ref.quote: Form M₂O (e.g., Na₂O); highly basic.

blocks.prompt:
44 Which example in Table 17.2 shows the less vigorous reaction of Group 2 metals with water?
(Table 17.2 mein Group 2 metals ke paani se kam tez reaction ki misaal kaun si hai?)

options.text: Ca aur paani, Mg aur steam

blocks.explanation: Group 1 bohat tezi, aksar dhamake se reaction karta hai (Na aur paani); Group 2 kam tezi se (Ca aur paani, Mg aur steam) (Table 17.2).

book_ref.quote: Less vigorous (e.g., Ca with water, Mg with steam).

blocks.prompt:
45 Compared with Group 1 metals, Group 2 metals have:
(Group 1 metals ke muqable mein Group 2 metals ki:)

options.text: zyada densities aur zyada melting points
kam densities aur kam melting points
kam densities aur zyada melting points

blocks.explanation: Group 2 metals ki densities aur melting/boiling points Group 1 se zyada hain (Table 17.2).

book_ref.quote: Higher densities than Group 1 metals.

blocks.prompt:
46 Compared with Group 1 hydroxides, Group 2 hydroxides are:
(Group 1 hydroxides ke muqable mein Group 2 hydroxides:)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 hydroxides Group 1 se kam hal hote hain (neeche solubility barhti hai) aur kam basic hain (Table 17.2).

book_ref.quote: Less soluble than Group 1, but solubility increases down the group

blocks.prompt:
47 In both Group 1 and Group 2, reactivity going down the group:
(Group 1 aur Group 2 dono mein group mein neeche jaate hue reactivity:)

options.text: pehle barhti phir kam hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Dono groups mein barhte atomic size aur ghatti ionization energy ki wajah se neeche reactivity barhti hai (17.3).

book_ref.quote: Both groups show increasing reactivity going down their respective groups

blocks.text: 17.4 Thermal Decomposition of Carbonates and Nitrates

blocks.prompt:
48 A reaction in which a single compound breaks down into two or more simpler substances on heating is called:
(Woh reaction jis mein aik compound garam karne par do ya zyada saada substances mein toot jaye, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermal decomposition (hararati tehleel) mein aik compound garam hone par do ya zyada saada substances mein toot jata hai (17.4).

book_ref.quote: Thermal decomposition is a chemical reaction, where a single compound breaks down

blocks.prompt:
49 Thermal decomposition is usually:
(Thermal decomposition aam tor par kaisa process hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein compound ke bonds todne ke liye energy chahiye, yani yeh endothermic (garmi jazb karne wala) hai (17.4).

book_ref.quote: This process usually requires energy (endothermic)

blocks.prompt:
50 On heating, MgCO₃ decomposes to give:
(Garam karne par MgCO₃ kis mein toot-ta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 carbonates MO aur CO₂ mein toot-te hain: MgCO₃(s) → MgO(s) + CO₂(g) (17.4).

book_ref.quote: Group 2 carbonates decompose upon heating to form a metal oxide (MO) and carbon dioxide gas

blocks.prompt:
51 The correct order of increasing thermal stability of Group 2 carbonates is:
(Group 2 carbonates ki barhti thermal stability ki sahi tarteeb kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbonates ki thermal stability neeche barhti hai; BaCO₃ ko tootne ke liye sab se zyada temperature (1360 °C) chahiye (17.4).

book_ref.quote: BaCO₃ requires the highest temperature to decompose

blocks.prompt:
52 According to Table 17.3, which carbonate decomposes at 900 °C?
(Table 17.3 ke mutabiq kaun sa carbonate 900 °C par toot-ta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 17.3: BeCO₃ 250, MgCO₃ 540, CaCO₃ 900, SrCO₃ 1289, BaCO₃ 1360 °C (17.4).

book_ref.quote: Table 17.3 Temperatures of decomposition of the Group 2 carbonates at 1 atm

blocks.prompt:
53 From Table 17.3, how much higher is the decomposition temperature of CaCO₃ than that of MgCO₃?
(Table 17.3 se, CaCO₃ ka decomposition temperature MgCO₃ se kitna zyada hai?)

book_ref.quote: Table 17.3 Temperatures of decomposition of the Group 2 carbonates at 1 atm

blocks.prompt:
54 BeCO₃ decomposes at a lower temperature than BaCO₃ because Be²⁺:
(BeCO₃ BaCO₃ se kam temperature par kyun toot-ta hai? Kyun ke Be²⁺:)

options.text: bara hai aur kam polarizing power rakhta hai
carbonate ion ko kheench nahi sakta
chhota hai aur zyada polarizing power rakhta hai

blocks.explanation: Chhota aur zyada charge wala Be²⁺ zyada polarizing power (bigaarne ki taqat) rakhta hai; yeh CO₃²⁻ ko zyada bigaar kar us ke bonds kamzor karta hai (17.4).

book_ref.quote: Smaller and highly charged cations (like Be²⁺) have a greater

blocks.prompt:
55 Down Group 2, the polarizing power of M²⁺ and the thermal stability of the carbonates respectively:
(Group 2 mein neeche M²⁺ ki polarizing power aur carbonates ki thermal stability tarteeb se:)

options.text: kam hoti hai; kam hoti hai

blocks.explanation: M²⁺ bara hone par polarizing power kam hoti hai, is liye carbonates zyada stable ho jate hain aur zyada garmi chahiye (17.4).

book_ref.quote: As the metal ion gets larger down the group, its polarizing power decreases

blocks.prompt:
56 Which substance is NOT a product of the thermal decomposition of a Group 2 nitrate?
(Group 2 nitrate ki thermal decomposition ka product kaun sa NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 nitrates metal oxide, bhoori NO₂ gas aur O₂ mein toot-te hain (17.4).

book_ref.quote: brown nitrogen dioxide gas (NO₂), and oxygen gas (O₂)

blocks.prompt:
57 The colour of the gas NO₂ given off when Group 2 nitrates are heated is:
(Group 2 nitrates garam karne par nikalne wali NO₂ gas ka rang kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 nitrates garam karne par bhoori (brown) NO₂ gas nikalti hai (17.4).

book_ref.quote: brown nitrogen dioxide gas (NO₂), and oxygen gas (O₂)

blocks.prompt:
58 Which Group 2 nitrate is the least thermally stable?
(Kaun sa Group 2 nitrate hararat ke liye sab se kam stable hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrates ki thermal stability group mein neeche barhti hai; Be(NO₃)₂ sab se kam aur Ba(NO₃)₂ sab se zyada stable (17.4).

book_ref.quote: Be(NO₃)₂ is the least stable, and Ba(NO₃)₂ is the most stable among them

blocks.prompt:
59 Nitrates at the top of Group 2 decompose at lower temperatures because the small M²⁺ ions:
(Group 2 ke upar wale nitrates kam temperature par kyun toot-te hain? Kyun ke chhote M²⁺ ions:)

options.text: nitrate ion ko door dhakelte hain
nitrate ion ko zyada bigaarte hain

blocks.explanation: Upar wale chhote M²⁺ ions NO₃⁻ ko zyada bigaarte hain, is liye us ka tootna aasaan hota hai (17.4).

book_ref.quote: distort the nitrate ion (NO₃⁻) more effectively

blocks.prompt:
60 In the balanced equation 2Ca(NO₃)₂ → 2CaO + x NO₂ + O₂, the value of x is:
(Balanced equation 2Ca(NO₃)₂ → 2CaO + x NO₂ + O₂ mein x ki value kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2Ca(NO₃)₂ mein 4 N atoms hain, is liye 4NO₂ banta hai (17.4).

book_ref.quote: brown nitrogen dioxide gas (NO₂), and oxygen gas (O₂)

blocks.prompt:
61 Observing the temperature at which a Group 2 carbonate decomposes helps chemists to:
(Group 2 carbonate ke tootne ka temperature dekh kar chemists kya kar sakte hain?)

options.text: carbonate ko hal pazeer bana sakte hain

blocks.explanation: Decomposition temperature dekh kar chemists na-maloom compounds pehchaan sakte hain aur khaas elements ki tasdeeq kar sakte hain (17.4).

book_ref.quote: chemists can identify the unknown compounds and confirm the presence of specific elements

blocks.prompt:
62 The energy released when gaseous ions are surrounded and attracted by water molecules is the:
(Gas wale ions jab paani ke molecules mein ghir jayein to kharij hone wali energy kya kehlati hai?)
